hub.headline:
Your first online sale
doesn't need a guru.
hub.lead: I help broke beginners get their first online sale with simple offers, honest copy, and organic traffic. No sales calls. No ad budget. No fake lifestyle.
hub.photo_alt: Rob Reece at his desk in front of the Cult Like Marketing banner
hub.card_line: Simple offers. Honest copy. Organic traffic.
hub.pain_title: You've done everything you were told to do.
pains: You've bought the course and still have no sale.
You post every day and nobody buys.
You don't know what to sell, or who to sell it to.
Your content reads like every other AI post, and people scroll past.
You're afraid of DMs and sales calls, so you hide.
hub.pain_close: That isn't a talent problem. It's a clarity problem. Fix the offer, the words, and the conversation, and sales follow.
hub.fix_title: Small offers. Sharp words. Real conversations.

fix_cards.title: Pick a small offer
fix_cards.text: A simple, low-priced product that solves one problem, so your first buyer says yes fast.

fix_cards.title: Write like a human
fix_cards.text: Direct-response copy that sounds like you at the kitchen table, not like a robot reading a script.

fix_cards.title: Sell without calls
fix_cards.text: Organic Facebook posts and friendly DMs. That's how I sell, and it's how I teach it.

hub.free_sub: Pick one. Enter your email. It lands in your inbox.
about: I'm a solo marketer. I build small offers, write the copy, and sell through organic Facebook posts and messages. No sales calls, ever.
I'm also a husband, a dad of a big family, and a minister. I run experiments in the open and hand you what works.

offers.title: The One-Chat Launchpad
offers.headline: Your Website, Lead Magnet and Signup Flow in One Chat
offers.sub: A master prompt, a starter template and two cheat sheets that let Claude build and publish your site while you stay in control.
includes: The master prompt that runs the whole build in one chat
A starter template (the same kind of generator this site is built on)
A Click Guide listing the few steps only you can do
A Rollback Card to undo a domain switch in about two minutes
needs: A Claude account. It works best with file tools and the Claude in Chrome extension. If Claude can't do a step, it walks you through it by hand.
Free accounts at GitHub and Cloudflare (you sign in yourself).
Optional: a domain from a registrar, roughly $10 to $25 a year, paid to the registrar.
not_for: Anyone who wants a promise of sales or income. Nobody honest can give you one.
Anyone who wants someone else to build and run it for them.
Email setup is not included. It's a separate add-on.
